headline.label: Change in fuel cost (horizon)
headline.description: Extra fuel cost over the horizon, after hedges. Positive means fuel costs more.

headline.label: Change in operating profit (horizon)
headline.description: Fare recovery minus the fuel-cost change, over the horizon.

headline.label: Change in operating margin
headline.description: Scenario margin minus baseline margin (0.01 is one percentage point).

headline.label: Steady-state annual operating-profit change
headline.description: The yearly operating-profit change in that steady state, after fare recovery.
